properties.NAME: LANE (Ore.)
properties.CHANGE: LANE (Ore.) gained from UMPQUA (Ore. Terr., extinct), gained from non-county area in Oregon Territory, and exchanged with DOUGLAS (Ore.). The portion of LANE in present Idaho was unchanged.
properties.CITATION: (Ore. Terr. Special Laws, 1853, 5th reg. sess., p. 13)
